1. Make sure you are in the root directory of your project.
2. Run the `prisma migrate reset --force` command. This will reset your database and migration history.

Please note that this command should only be used on a development database, not on a production database. If you're unsure, it's best to back up your data before proceeding.

To fix schema drift in your project, you need to perform a full database reset. This will drop the database, recreate it, apply all migrations, and run seed scripts. Here's how you can do it:

1. Make sure you are in the root directory of your project.
2. Run the following command:

```bash
npx prisma migrate reset --force
```

This command will reset your database and migration history to align with your Prisma schema. Please note that this should only be done on a development database, not on a production database. If you have any important data, ensure it is backed up before proceeding.
